changes: Rewrote /agent/solver.md. Several failed runs submitted after 0–2 tool calls with no run_tests or brute-force check, so I made verification a mandatory gate: run_tests on examples, then one brute-force comparison, then one timing run, all before submit. I added guidance on the failure patterns seen in the logs: DP over counts with a large candidate range (lcb-3638 timed out), checking Dijkstra cost definitions by hand on the examples (lcb-3655), and validating GF(2) XOR outputs by plugging them back in (lcb-abc366-g). I also required verification runs to stay small (under about 5 s), since a timed-out check was hiding real bugs. One trial on lcb-3655 now runs the public tests and then fails on a hidden-test wrong answer; its brute-force run timed out, which motivated the small-run rule. I did not trial the other changes, and validate() reports OK.
